data.name: Null Hørizøn
data.detailed_description:
SURVIVE THE FRONTIER. FOLLOW THE SIGNAL.

Null Horizon is a first-person space sim about making money and staying alive at the edge of civilized space. Take contracts, haul cargo, hunt pirates, smuggle contraband, salvage wrecks, and upgrade your ship as you push deeper into dangerous sectors in search of a lost evacuation signal.

CURRENT FEATURES

- Pilot 17 ships, from fast fighters and cargo haulers to deep-space explorers and rare unlockable vessels

- Explore procedurally generated sectors filled with stations, traders, pirates, hazards, distress calls, resource fields, and stranger things in deep space

- Fight real-time starship battles from the cockpit by managing weapons, shields, energy, and ship systems under pressure

- Trade, mine, salvage, craft, and smuggle to build your ship, grow your credits, and survive longer runs into the void

- Earn trust or infamy with six factions, affecting docking access, jobs, prices, and who treats you like a customer or a target

- Build a fleet, recruit allied ships, and send squadrons on combat, escort, survey, and support missions

- Take on courier, patrol, bounty, survey, and smuggling jobs while following a story about a signal coming from beyond mapped space

The deeper you go, the better the rewards, the stronger the enemies, and the fewer safe places remain.

                                              Prepare for departure, Captain. The Null Horizon is calling.

data.short_description: Survive the void in Null Hørizøn. Trade, fight, and explore a retro-futuristic 3D galaxy with 2D sprites. Upgrade your ship, smuggle goods, and travel across the universe. Tactical Real-Time combat meets Grid-based exploration in this atmospheric space sim. The Null Hørizøn calls, Captain.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core (Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Runs on most integrated graphics cards.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Quad Core or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
